entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi Sarah... I'm calling because I need to return my new VeloBand Pulse. I'm just so disappointed with it.
Oh, I'm very sorry to hear that you're not happy with it. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

It's not broken, I just find it incredibly **hard to use**. I've read the **user manual** twice and the interface is so **confusing**. Honestly, I **expected more**. I've been a VeloFit customer for years and I'm just sad it didn't work out. I really needed this money for other things, you know?
I completely understand your frustration. When a product isn't intuitive, it can definitely be a letdown. Let me just pull up your order details and check the return eligibility for you. One moment.
Okay, thank you. I was just really hoping it would be simple.
Alright, I have your order pulled up here. Let me see... okay, according to our policy, all items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery.
Oh, really? So... I can return it? I got it about three weeks ago.
Yes, absolutely. Three weeks is well within the 90-day window. I can process that return for you right now and get a shipping label sent over to your email.
Wow, that's such a relief! Thank you so much, Sarah. You have no idea how much I appreciate that. I was so worried I was stuck with it.

It's my pleasure to help. I've just sent that label to the email we have on file. You should receive it in the next 5 minutes. Just print it out, attach it to the box, and you can drop it off at any post office.
That's perfect. Thank you again, you've really helped me out.
You're very welcome. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
